lead: Our own construction crew with a site manager: we carry out every type of renovation work — from demolition and electrics to tiling, painting and furniture assembly. We work under a contract and an estimate.
about: A crew you do not need to babysit

The main problem with renovation crews is missed deadlines and a price that keeps growing. We work under a contract and a detailed estimate, and a site manager checks every stage. You get reports and pay for completed stages.
When needed, we bring in a designer and an engineer: drawings help the crew work precisely and without rework.
A renovation company, not a random crew

Looking for a renovation crew, it is easy to end up with “handymen from an ad” with no contract and no warranty. CAS Development has been a renovation company since 2016: three in-house salaried crews for different levels of complexity and types of work, plus a site manager, estimator and material supply. 150+ completed projects and a 36-month warranty on works.
As a renovation company we are responsible for the whole site: from demolition to turnkey renovation and design implementation, and, if needed, turnkey furnishing with furniture and lighting.
steps: We visit the site and assess the scope.
Works and materials itemised line by line.
Price, timeline and stages are fixed.
The crew follows the schedule, the site manager checks quality.
Work is handed over stage by stage and signed off.
faq: What work does your crew do?
A full turnkey renovation or individual stages: demolition, electrics, plumbing, plastering, tiling, flooring, painting, ceilings, furniture assembly.
How much does a renovation crew cost?

Turnkey renovation from $550 per m². The price from $550/m² covers works and rough materials; finishing materials, furniture and appliances are priced separately in the estimate. Individual works are priced after measuring; the price is fixed in the estimate, and if CAS renovates, the total stays within ±5%.
Always — with an estimate, schedule and payment stages.
Do you buy the materials yourselves?
We can purchase and deliver everything ourselves, including directly from China, or work with your materials.
Are you a crew or a renovation company?
A renovation company with our own crews: we work under a contract, with an estimate, a site manager and a 36-month warranty on works.
Do you renovate to someone else’s design project?
Yes. First we check the drawings and prepare an estimate, then carry out the renovation and, if you wish, purchase materials and furniture.
